source_note: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题
english_source_note: Criteria for Density of Sequences in an Interval
callout_id: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题#1
statement_en: Let $(x_n)$ be a bounded sequence with $\limsup_{n\to\infty} x_n = b$ and $\liminf_{n\to\infty} x_n = a$, where $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$ and $a\neq b$. If $\lim_{n\to\infty}(x_{n+1}-x_n)=0$, then the sequence is dense in $(a,b)$.
callout_body: 有界序列$x_n$上极限为$b$,下极限为$a$（$a,b$皆为实数$a\neq b$）。如果$\lim_{n\to \infty} (x_{n+1}-x_n) =0$，那么序列在区间$(a,b)$内稠密。
